milestone: Portable note formatting and native reading
status: Implemented independently in both apps; scoped phone/tablet flows accepted. Mac native acceptance and other rank-3 work remain open.
storage: Existing task description string remains canonical; formatting edits plain Markdown. No schema migration, webpage/image fetch or external editor.
behavior: Selection-based bold, italic, headings, bulleted/numbered lists, quotes, code and web links
Separate editable draft, native preview, Apply and discard confirmation
Applying to a new task or pinned note stays local until the existing parent Save
Existing task/workspace/generation and concurrent note changes rechecked before Apply
Mac uses existing durable Store/Workspace save and Undo; failed save retains formatting draft for retry
Complete original text available; oversized/fragmented notes fall back to literal original without truncating stored content
Bounded readable task/widget previews; existing accessible full task-row notes retained at large accessibility sizes
Only HTTP/HTTPS links without embedded credentials; executable links, embedded images, HTML and extended attributes remain literal

coverage: Inline toggle/placeholders and embedded backtick delimiters
Bounded widget projections, account filtering and unchanged raw note
Compact task previews and retained link destinations

native_iphone.result: Four actual UI cases pass on final source, no skipped cases or runtime warnings
cases: Format then Cancel/discard preserves exact original draft/account snapshot
Replace selected placeholder, Heading, Preview, Apply, parent Save and normal relaunch preserve exact source
Largest accessibility text in dark appearance keeps writing, Preview and Apply available without premature task creation
Existing task Format/Apply does not bypass parent Save; exact source persists after normal relaunch
native_iphone.screenshots: Normal light and largest-text dark previews inspected; labels/actions readable and no clipping

native_ipad.result: Pinned note Preview/Save/relaunch passes in v1. Final source Cancel/discard and existing-task parent-Save/relaunch pass in v2; largest-text dark Preview/Apply passes in v3.
native_ipad.initial_finding: First run Cancel case did not open the sheet after typing. Its event used y=682, while the final accessibility snapshot placed Format notes at y=495; no data changed. Added explicit parent focus handoff and field-value assertions. The final native Cancel flow passes without a second tap. Initial largest-text run also hit repeated 60-second animation waits; explicit Preview focus resignation is now in both apps, and final tablet largest-text flow finishes in 33 seconds.
native_ipad.screenshots: Normal light and largest-text dark preview inspected; content/actions readable without clipping.

archived_v1.result: Two passes, one failed opening tap; full superseded failure bundle pruned after final focused acceptance.

native_mac.result: Final isolated owned Mac app builds and strict deep signature verification passes; native editing, Undo/failure recovery and VoiceOver acceptance remain pending.

limits: Print/PDF, grouping/gesture controls and hierarchy filter grammar not part of this milestone
Real signing/distribution and previously deferred provider/server work remain deferred
cleanup: Superseded full results pruned; final passing results and diagnostic/visual evidence retained. All main Taskfold test apps closed.

current_followup.scope: Scoped local iOS save failure/retry and concurrent saved-state refusal; independent shared error-layout fixes; older fields retain their original historical scope.
